data_kind: real NEA, SIMBAD, and Gaia DR3 archive products
limitations: A Gaia motion is accepted only when the nearest candidate lies within 1 arcsec of the NEA position and has finite proper motion. A large nearest/second candidate margin is evidence against confusion, not an identifier proof. The uncertainty column propagates Gaia errors only; NEA/SIMBAD coordinate errors and their exact reference epochs are unavailable here, so no full significance is claimed.
